sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Solitaire TriPeaks Garden is a solitaire game with a twist. Instead of the traditional layout, the game uses a tripeaks format, where three cards are revealed at the top of the screen. Your goal is to remove all the cards from the game by matching them in sequences or suit. The game's unique mechanics make it challenging yet accessible, and the addition of power-ups and special moves adds a layer of complexity that will keep you engaged for hours.

One of the key features of Solitaire TriPeaks Garden is its use of a cat companion. Throughout your journey, your cat will provide you with guidance and support, offering tips and suggestions on how to improve your gameplay.
